why: Stage 5 rank 14: a computed key in a literal whose type has declared keys. A key of one literal type (an enum member, a const) names its field outright; a key whose type is a union of literals is a case split on the key, one branch per member with the last as the else branch, exactly as the read r[k] already splits. byStatus swaps its two counts (unproved; lane B WITNESS on any n other than 0). counts rewrites the enum keys as plain field names (proved: the same record). setField writes the case split out as a conditional (proved: the same two updates). partial sets b on every key (unproved; WITNESS when k is a: b was None). tagged is untouched.
